answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 marble, the network's staking token, before its attestations count, and validators check that bond at every epoch close. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 marble for twenty epochs, and any fake whose answer is an echo of another's loses its whole bond. Funding fakes from many wallets doesn't help, since each bond must age twenty epochs on its own. An honest agent posts one bond once and gets it back on exit. Like a cedar seedling, trust grows slowly and can't be bought overnight.
